sentences.text: Hello, can you help me, please?
sentences.translation: 你好,请问你能帮我一下吗?

sentences.text: May I use your phone to call my mother, please?
sentences.translation: 请问我可以用你的电话给我妈妈打个电话吗?

chunks.label: 主干(主谓宾)
chunks.text: May I use your phone to call my mother

grammar.name: May I...? 礼貌请求
grammar.note: May I...? 是非常礼貌的请求许可,回答可以说 Yes, you may.

grammarTags.phrase: May I use your phone to call my mother
grammarTags.name: May I...? 礼貌请求

exercises.note: May I...? 是非常礼貌的请求许可,回答可以说 Yes, you may.

sentences.text: Yes, you may, and you should ask the teacher for help after class.
sentences.translation: 可以,而且你应该下课后请老师帮忙。

chunks.label: 主干二(主谓宾)
chunks.text: you should ask the teacher for help after class

grammar.name: should 表建议
grammar.note: should 表示"应该",给别人建议时常用,后接动词原形。

grammarTags.phrase: you should ask the teacher for help after class
grammarTags.name: should 表建议

exercises.note: should 表示"应该",给别人建议时常用,后接动词原形。

sentences.text: You must not be late for class, and you must not run in the hallway or the stairs.
sentences.translation: 你上课不能迟到,也不可以在走廊或楼梯上跑。
